newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ortiz says talked to Tietmeyer on Mexico, Europe.
newsitem.headline: Ortiz says talked to Tietmeyer on Mexico, Europe.

text.p: Mexico's finance minister Guillermo Ortiz said on Monday he had met Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer earlier in the day to discuss general issues relating to Mexico and Europe.
"Tietmeyer was very pleased with the direction we are going in Mexico," Ortiz said at a presentation to economic analysts and journalists in Frankfurt.

Ortiz, who attended the World Economic Forum in Davos last week, reiterated the belief that economic growth Mexico, which plunged into recession in 1995 after the shock devaluation of the peso, could rise above four percent in 1997.
He added that the country would be making a "decisive effort" to increase the rate of growth to six percent or higher over the medium-term.
